title: HS50015: Economics Of Information
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: HS50001Course ContentsIntroduction: Information and its
importance; Information goods: Pricing, versioning, Digital media and
bandwidth, rights management; Decision-making under uncertainty: Expected
utility, Risk aversion; Constrained optimization: Kuhn-Tucker conditions;
Hidden actions (moral hazard): Incentives for managers, Insurance; Adverse
selection: market for lemons, credit rationing, insurance markets, bid-ask
spread; Screening: Insurance markets; Signaling: Market for lemons, education
as a signal; Incentive mechanisms: Auctions: Effects on market prices and
allocations.
